title: Perplexity provider generateText crashes
body:
### Description

perplexity is currently returning `null` as `finish_reason` on some of the calls (likely error on their side). The zod validation schema on `generateText` expects a non-nullable string which causes the whole response to fail. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5592b92d-8114-4382-9edb-b95bb70642db)

```
  Error message: [
    {
      "code": "invalid_type",
      "expected": "string",
      "received": "null",
      "path": [
        "choices",
        0,
        "finish_reason"
      ],
      "message": "Expected string, received null"
    }

```
